A '''battle''' near [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] resulting in a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] victory<ref name="Rebel Assault" /> occurred in approximately [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

For his part in the successful engagement, young Rebel [[Merrick Simms]] was highly acclaimed and quickly promoted to the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]].<ref name="Rebel Assault" />
